title: Zesty Canadian Chicken Curry
description: A citrusy and juicy Canadian dish featuring dried red chillies, cooked in a clay pot, and friendly to the ayurvedic sattvic diet. This recipe is perfect for a weeknight dinner.

ingredients.name: dried red chillies
ingredients.notes: crushed or 1 teaspoon red chilli powder

instructions: Heat oil in a clay pot over medium heat.
Add the crushed dried red chillies and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken and cook until it is browned on all sides.
Add the curry powder and cook for 1 minute.
Add the coconut milk and lemon juice and stir well.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through.
Serve hot over rice or with naan bread.
